## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D fighting game inspired by *The Raid: Redemption*.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game in `index.html` using Three.js from jsDelivr.
- Chose a prison-yard setting: fight three hostiles, then reach the yellow gate; keyboard and touch controls are supported.

## Work State

### Completed
- Created a 3D prison yard, player and enemy fighters, HUD, title screen, combat, dodge, enemy AI, health/stamina, and victory/defeat states in `index.html`.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Confirmed the module parses with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs`.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/current.jpg` and `screenshots/yard.jpg`.

### Active
- Fix Three.js geometry `NaN` errors and continue browser testing.

### Blocked
- Browser console reports 11 errors: `THREE.BufferGeometry.computeBoundingSphere(): Computed radius is NaN. The "position" attribute is likely to have NaN values. BoxGeometry`.
- Initial browser session also reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), and the title font is loaded from Google Fonts.
- The initial gameplay screenshot was checked, but no complete combat/victory playthrough has been validated.

## Next Move
1. Find the source of the invalid BoxGeometry values; inspect and validate arguments passed through `box()` and all `BoxGeometry` constructors.
2. Reload in Playwright and confirm the NaN errors are gone.
3. Exercise movement, attacks, enemy damage, and the gate/victory flow; fix any issues found.
4. Save and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot after the fixes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: Initial title-screen browser screenshot.
- `screenshots/yard.jpg`: Initial gameplay browser screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The game runs at `http://localhost:3002`; server was started in the background.
- Browser testing used `playwright-cli`; Chromium was installed during testing.
- The JavaScript module syntax check passed, but browser testing found repeated NaN BoxGeometry errors.
